run_PPO_training: run the PPO discrete policy gradient training loop with configurable time limit and learning epochs
create_PPO_instance: create a PPO instance with config, environment factory, and agent factory for discrete action spaces
review_PPO_get_loss: review the PPO get_loss method that computes value loss, PPO surrogate loss, and entropy loss from trajectories
summarize_PPO_get_gae: summarize the PPO get_gae method that computes Generalized Advantage Estimation with configurable discount and lambda
test_PPO_evaluate: test the PPO evaluate method that computes average reward from evaluation batcher trajectories and logs metrics
